title: Icons executor
description: Downloads a pinned Phosphor icon archive, extracts a single weight into the BeeQ icon assets folder, and stores a fingerprint marker for idempotent runs.

assetsFolder.description: Assets directory inside the downloaded archive root.

downloadPath.description: Directory (relative to workspace root) where the archive is downloaded.

extractToPath.description: Destination directory (relative to workspace root) for flattened SVG files.

sourceUrl.description: Base URL used to fetch the archive.

sourceRef.description: Pinned immutable source ref (tag or commit SHA) — participates in the cache fingerprint.

sourceChecksum.description: Optional expected sha256 checksum of the archive (format: sha256-<64 hex chars>).

svgFolder.description: Archive root folder name containing icon assets.

metadataFile.description: Metadata marker file written inside extractToPath.

force.description: Always refresh icons even when metadata matches.

skipIfUpToDate.description: Skip download/extract when existing icons and metadata match the expected fingerprint.

keepDownload.description: Keep the downloaded archive after successful extraction.

minSvgCount.description: Minimum SVG files required for a valid extraction.
